    """Apply non-overlapping [start, end, replacement] edits to text simultaneously.

    Indices are code-point offsets into the original text.
    Edits are non-overlapping, sorted by start, and based on the original text.
    Half-open intervals are used; start == end inserts.

    for start, end, replacement in edits:
        result.append(text[current:start])
        result.append(replacement)
        current = end
    result.append(text[current:])
    return "".join(result)
